open(base+'/task-383dbda3.py','w').write('''import numpy as np
from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    a = np.array(grid)
    cnt = Counter(a.flat)
    blk = max((c for c in cnt if c != 0), key=lambda c: cnt[c])
    other = sorted(set(a.flat) - {0, blk})[0]
    bm = np.argwhere(a == blk); on = np.argwhere(a == other)
    r0, r1 = bm[:,0].min(), bm[:,0].max()
    c0, c1 = bm[:,1].min(), bm[:,1].max()
    H, W = a.shape
    out = a.copy()
    for r in range(r0, r1+1):
        row_noise = [cc for rr, cc in on if rr == r]
        lo = 0
        hi = W
        for cc in row_noise:
            if cc < c0: lo = max(lo, c1+1)
            if cc > c1: hi = min(hi, c0)
        out[r, lo:hi] = blk
    for c in range(c0, c1+1):
        below = any(rr > r1 and cc == c for rr, cc in on)
        bot = r0 if below else H
        out[:bot, c] = blk
    for r, c in on:
        out[r, c] = other
    return out.tolist()
''')
